Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Νοεμβρίου, «Αγία Όλγα της Αλάσκας, η Μαία», with the rank word left off.

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «Sfânta Olga (Arrsamquq) s-a născut la 3 februarie 1916, în satul Kwethluk din Alaska».

death.note: doxologia.ro: «A plecat din această lume în ziua de 8 noiembrie 1979, după ce s-a rugat, s-a spovedit și s-a împărtășit».

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Νοεμβρίου — «Αγία Όλγα της Αλάσκας, η Μαία»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and it is the day of her repose: «Η Matushka Όλγα αναπαύτηκε στις 8 Νοεμβρίου του 1979 μ.Χ.». The entry is the same woman the folder already keeps — the Yup'ik midwife of Kwethluk, born 3 February 1916, wife of the village postmaster who was later ordained — but the Greek calendar keeps her on her repose, 8 November, where doxologia keeps her on 27 October; the Romanian row is left exactly as it stands. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it prints no hymn.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
